title: Supervisor de Importação e Exportação
description:
A Brink’s é uma empresa líder global em gestão de numerário e valores, soluções digitais para o varejo e serviços gerenciados de ATM.

Nossos clientes incluem instituições financeiras, varejistas, órgãos governamentais, casas da moeda, joalherias e outras operações comerciais. Nossa rede de operações em 51 países atende clientes em mais de 100 países.

Acreditamos na construção de parcerias que protegem o comércio, e isso exige fomentar uma cultura engajada que valorize pessoas com diferentes origens, ideias e perspectivas.

Construímos um senso de pertencimento, para que todos os colaboradores se sintam respeitados, seguros e valorizados, e oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades para participação e crescimento.


Como pessoa Supervisora de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por liderar e garantir toda a documentação necessária para os embarques nos processos de importação e exportação, cumprindo prazos e especificações dos órgãos legais e conforme determinação contratual.


Responsabilidades


  • Supervisionar diariamente no sistema da Receita Federal a existência de novos pedidos de embarque, acionando as áreas envolvidas e tomando as medidas necessárias;
  • Supervisionar o time quanto à documentação emitida a fim de evitar embarques incorretos;
  • Manter contato permanente com clientes externos e internos (nacional e internacional), avaliando a necessidade de correções de documentos e providenciando-os, a fim de manter os padrões exigidos pela legislação evitando penalidades e multas perante as alfândegas brasileira e do exterior;
  • Manter contato com o departamento de controle das filiais a fim de acompanhar as coletas (exportação) e entregas (importação) e posicionar Brink's e clientes quanto aos embarques cuja contratação é \"porta a porta\";
  • Supervisionar atividades administrativas como conferências e pagamento de frete aéreo internacional e valores a serem faturados;
  • Conhecer e interpretar os Inconterms (negociações entre importador e exportador) e providenciar instruções de emissão de documentos de acordo com o Incoterm negociado;
  • Seguir procedimentos internos de segurança e sigilo da informação;
  • Manter o cliente devidamente informado de todos os passos/acontecimentos do processo;
  • Participar dos programas de melhoria contínua e disseminar novas propostas de processos junto ao time.


Desafios


  • Garantir que os processos de importação e exportação ocorram de maneira correta e eficaz, providenciando todos os documentos necessários para embarque para exportação e conferência na importação, cumprindo os prazos estabelecidos e evitando penalidades e sanções.

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.


Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.


This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.


We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.


If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!



Job challenges:

- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;

- Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;

- Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;

- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;

- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;

- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.

- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.

- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.

- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;

- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;

- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;


Requirements:

- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;

- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;

- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;

- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);

- Intermediate Excel skills;

- Desirable: Bachelor’s degree;

- Desirable: Experience with eSocial system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).



Benefits we offer:

- Food allowance;

- Transportation allowance without discount;

- Health and dental plan at no cost;

- Life insurance;

- Private pension;

- Profit-Sharing;

- WellHub Membership.



If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.



All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Supervisor de ROV
description:

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

title: Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Senior Full Stack Java - React Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient software applications. Your role will involve leading technical projects, mentoring junior engineers, and continuously improving software development practices to ensure the delivery of robust and reliable software systems.


Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, Java, and Spring Boot across frontend and backend layers;
  • Architect and implement robust RESTful APIs, real-time data integrations, and high-performance backend services with proper caching and optimization strategies;
  • Build modern, responsive, and highly interactive user interfaces, integrating streaming data, advanced search, and filtering capabilities;
  • Contribute to system design decisions, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments while ensuring high engineering standards and best practices.


Essential Skills


  • Experience with strong full-stack expertise in both frontend and backend;
  • Advanced proficiency in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6+), including strong CSS skills (Flexbox, Grid, responsive design);
  • Experience with UI frameworks such as MUI, Tailwind, or Ant Design, and solid frontend testing experience;
  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot, designing and building scalable, secure RESTful APIs;
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis);
  • Strong understanding of system design principles, caching mechanisms, and performance optimization in distributed systems;
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and real-time or streaming data solutions;
  • Hands-on experience with message brokers such as Kafka and search technologies like Elasticsearch;
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS preferred; GCP, Azure, or OCI acceptable);
  • Strong knowledge of Git and GitHub workflows (branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines including GitHub Actions.

description:
Gestor de Tráfego Pago (Mídia Paga) **CARGO 100% EM INGLÊS**


Meta e Google Ads

Localização: Remoto – Somente residentes no Brasil (deve ter disponibilidade para trabalhar no fuso horário Mountain Standard Time (MST) dos EUA)

Tipo de Contratação: Prestador de Serviços (Pessoa Jurídica)

Sobre a Viral Coach

A Viral Coach ajuda empresas a aumentarem sua visibilidade e presença de marca por meio de redes sociais orgânicas, anúncios pagos e estratégias de marketing digital. Nossa equipe inclui especialistas com experiência em empresas como Amazon, PayPal, NerdWallet, entre outras. Trabalhamos com pequenas e médias empresas (faturamento entre US$ 1M e US$ 50M) e estamos crescendo rapidamente para acompanhar a demanda dos clientes.


Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Gestor de Tráfego Pago com experiência em Meta e Google Ads, que seja ao mesmo tempo estrategista, analítico e executor. Você trabalhará diretamente com clientes da Viral Coach para auditar, gerenciar e otimizar suas estratégias de mídia paga.

Dependendo das necessidades de cada cliente, sua atuação poderá variar entre consultoria estratégica de alto nível e gestão completa de campanhas. Você terá um papel fundamental em ajudar empresários a crescer por meio de mídia paga, garantindo que cada investimento gere resultados mensuráveis.


Principais Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de anúncios para múltiplos clientes
  • Gerenciar múltiplas campanhas e objetivos de marketing, com consultoria em funis e estratégia geral
  • Administrar e escalar orçamentos elevados (entre 5 e 6 dígitos por mês em múltiplas contas)
  • Configurar contas de anúncios, implementar pixels e rastreamento de eventos
  • Colaborar diretamente com clientes, garantindo comunicação clara e alinhamento de metas e estratégia
  • Organizar e testar variações criativas mensalmente
  • Fornecer relatórios semanais de desempenho com insights estratégicos
  • Manter boas práticas em estrutura de campanhas, orçamento e configurações técnicas
  • Responder a solicitações de clientes em até 24 horas úteis
  • Colaborar de forma assíncrona via Slack e outras ferramentas


Requisitos
  • Inglês fluente (nível nativo)
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência com mídia paga
  • Gestão de mais de US$ 5 milhões em investimento total em anúncios
  • Experiência gerenciando 45+ contas simultaneamente em agência ou ambiente de alto volume
  • Forte entendimento de marketing, funis e otimização de conversão
  • Habilidade analítica para interpretar dados e orientar decisões estratégicas
  • Familiaridade com HubSpot e GoHighLevel (GHL)
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a resultados


Remuneração

Salário base de US$ 2.750 mensais , com possibilidade de bônus por desempenho.

Explicação detalhada da remuneração:

OTE (ganhos totais estimados): entre US$ 3.875 e US$ 5.000 mensais


Cultura

Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo, com alto padrão de performance e zero drama. Crescemos quando nossos clientes crescem.


Flexibilidade

Modelo remoto, de segunda a sexta-feira, com atuação alinhada ao fuso horário MST dos EUA.


Suporte

Cultura colaborativa de alta performance, focada em extrair o melhor de cada membro do time.


Processo Seletivo

Nosso processo avalia experiência, abordagem e alinhamento com os valores da Viral Coach.

Inclui um vídeo inicial de apresentação e, para candidatos selecionados, um teste prático com análise de dados de campanhas e recomendações estratégicas.

Os candidatos aprovados serão convidados para entrevista.


Como se candidatar

1) Em inglês: Envie um vídeo de apresentação (máx. 5 minutos) usando Loom ou outra ferramenta gratuita, respondendo:

  • Why you’re excited about this role and how your experience aligns.
  • What makes you a great fit for our fast-paced digital brand.
  • An example of how you handled a difficult situation with a client client and how you remedied it
  • Your availability to interview and ideal start date.

2) Envie o link do vídeo + seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail: Intro Video – Media Buyer – (Seu Nome)


Your Application should be in 100% English.


English Job Description:

Media Buyer (Meta and Google Ads)

Location: Remote – Brazilian Residents ONLY (must be available to work in U.S. Mountain Standard Timezone hours)

Job Type: Independent Contractor

Industry: Digital Marketing


About Viral Coach

Viral Coach helps businesses grow visibility and brand presence through organic social media, paid ads, and digital marketing strategies. Our team includes social media experts with backgrounds at Amazon, PayPal, NerdWallet, and more. We work with small-to-medium sized businesses ($1–50M revenue) and are expanding quickly to support client growth.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Media Buyer with Meta & Google Ads experience who’s equal parts strategist, optimizer, and expert. You’ll work directly with Viral Coach clients to audit, manage, and optimize their paid advertising strategies.

Depending on each client’s needs, your work will range from high-level coaching and performance reviews to full-stack campaign management. You’ll play a key role in helping business owners understand how to grow through paid media while ensuring every dollar spent delivers measurable results.


Key Responsibilities
  • Manage & optimize ad campaigns across clients
  • Manage multiple campaigns & marketing goals, consulting on funnels, and general marketing strategy
  • Handle and scale large daily budgets (5–6 figures/month across accounts)
  • Oversee ad account setup, pixel implementation, and event tracking for clients
  • Collaborate directly with clients to ensure clear communication and alignment on campaign goals, strategy, and performance
  • Organize and test creative variations monthly across accounts
  • Provide weekly performance reports and insights to clients
  • Maintain best practices in campaign structure, budgeting, and tech setup
  • Respond to all client requests within 24 business hours
  • Collaborate asynchronously via Slack and shared tools


Requirements
  • Native-level English fluency
  • 4+ years of media buying experience
  • Managed $5M+ in lifetime ad spend
  • Experience managing 45+ client accounts simultaneously in an agency or high-volume environment
  • Strong understanding of marketing, funnel strategy, and conversion optimization
  • Strong data-analytic skills to interpret data and guide strategy and performance
  • Familiarity with HubSpot & GHL
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-motivated, organized, and results-driven


Compensation
  • $2,750 USD monthly base salary with potential for performance incentive bonus
  • Compensation breakdown:
  • OTE (On Track Earnings): $3,875 – $5,000/month


Culture

Fast-paced, collaborative, high standards, zero drama. We win by making our clients win.


Flexibility

Remote role, Monday–Friday, aligned with your time zone (must overlap with MST hours).


Support

Collaborative, high-performance culture that pushes everyone to perform at their best.


Our Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to assess experience, approach, and alignment with Viral Coach values.

It includes an initial Loom introduction video. Selected candidates will then complete a short practical knowledge exam, where you’ll review sample ad data and provide strategic recommendations.

Candidates will then be invited to interview.


How to Apply

1) Submit a Video Introduction (max 5 minutes) using Loom or another free tool. Please cover:

  • Why you’re excited about this role and how your experience aligns
  • What makes you a great fit for a fast-paced digital brand
  • An example of how you handled a difficult client situation and how you resolved it
  • Your availability to interview and ideal start date

2) Send your video link + resume to:

Subject line: Intro Video – Media Buyer – (Your Name)


Equal Opportunity Employer

Viral Coach is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all team members.

description:

The Growth Success Lead (SMB Portfolio Lead) will focus on identifying high-potential small and medium businesses (SMBs) in their hub and supporting them with corporate partnerships, market access, funding access, and growth strategies .


Key Responsibilities:


1. SMB Identification & Engagement

  • Experience with public procurement and corporate partnerships is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, business advisory, and project management skills.

title: Senior SAP Tax Specialist
description:
Senior SAP Tax Specialist

São Paulo, Brazil


Project: Brazil Localization (S/4HANA)

Contract: 6‑month contract + extension

Start: Immediate / ASAP

Work Model: Hybrid – 3 days on‑site / 2 days remote


Overview


We are seeking a Senior SAP Tax Specialist to lead the tax workstream for a major SAP S/4HANA implementation at a large multinational organisation within the consumer / retail sector in Brazil.


This role acts as the technical and strategic reference for Brazilian taxation, ensuring that complex local tax requirements are fully compliant and seamlessly integrated into global SAP processes. The consultant will also contribute to innovation initiatives, including the use of AI‑enabled tools in tax automation and analytics.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Brazil Localization solutions covering direct and indirect taxes, ensuring end‑to‑end compliance and process integrity.
  • Configure and optimise TAXBRA and/or partner tax engines (e.g. Thomson Reuters / ONESOURCE where applicable).
  • Ensure compliance with ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS and withholding tax requirements.
  • Lead integration between SAP Tax and MM, SD, FI and Logistics processes.
  • Translate Brazilian legal and fiscal changes into clear SAP system requirements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT stakeholders on Brazilian tax strategy within SAP.


Technical Skills & Experience


  • Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA and New General Ledger / Universal Journal in a tax context.
  • Hands‑on experience with Condition‑Based Tax (CBT) and Exception / Pivot Table mapping.
  • Experience with TDF (Tax Declaration Framework) and/or ACR (Advanced Compliance Reporting).
  • Solid knowledge of SPED Fiscal, SPED Contributions and EFD‑REINF.
  • Experience with tax‑relevant supplier and material master data sanitisation.
  • Ability to leverage AI‑based tools or coding assistants to accelerate tax rule mapping and data analysis.


Please apply now with your updated CV for immediate consideration.

title: Especialista Segurança do Trabalho (Porto)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú



O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil



No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time?

Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Localidade:


Santos/SP



Desafio:


Aplicar as estratégias de Segurança do trabalho e Emergências, trabalhando na prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde ocupacional, fazendo cumprir as normas de segurança, monitorando indicadores, se antecipando e evitando situações de Emergências e/ou acidentes, garantindo a consolidação da cultura de segurança, visando um ambiente seguro para todos os colaboradores e minimizando riscos operacionais em sua área de atuação (Fábrica, Logística ou Porto)..


Principais Atividades:


  • Elaborar, implementar, manter e garantir a aprovação de políticas e programas de Segurança do Trabalho, assegurando conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e com as necessidades das áreas de atuação (Fábrica, Logística e Porto), promovendo a cultura de segurança.
  • Identificar, avaliar e controlar riscos ocupacionais por meio de APRs, inspeções de segurança e estudos de impacto, elaborando planos de ação para mitigação ou eliminação de riscos como agentes químicos, trabalho em altura, incêndio, movimentação de cargas, operação de empilhadeiras e manobra de vagões.
  • Definir, gerenciar e monitorar o uso adequado de EPIs, garantindo conformidade com a NR‑6, incluindo gestão de contratos, treinamentos, conscientização e fiscalização da utilização correta.
  • Planejar, organizar e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e periódicos (NR‑10, NR‑11, NR‑12, NR‑33, NR‑35, entre outros), além de treinamentos de direção defensiva para motoristas e operadores, promovendo campanhas de segurança, emergências e saúde ocupacional.
  • Capacitar equipes de emergência e primeiros socorros para atuação em acidentes e situações críticas.
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas em armazéns, pátios, veículos, equipamentos, máquinas e infraestrutura, garantindo conformidade com as NRs, legislação vigente e padrões de segurança da Arauco.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas, externas e de certificação (OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001), acompanhando e implementando planos de ação para melhoria contínua da segurança.
  • Investigar acidentes e incidentes, aplicando metodologias definidas, elaborando relatórios técnicos, revisando procedimentos e promovendo treinamentos preventivos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar programas de segurança e direção defensiva para transporte rodoviário, monitorando a condução dos motoristas, o uso de tacógrafos, sistemas de rastreamento e o cumprimento das normas de trânsito.
  • Garantir a segurança na movimentação de cargas (amarração, empilhamento, carga e descarga), prevenindo acidentes operacionais e danos ao produto.
  • Supervisionar o uso de empilhadeiras e equipamentos de movimentação, assegurando que os operadores sejam treinados e certificados conforme a NR‑11.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar indicadores de segurança (acidentes, incidentes, absenteísmo, taxa de frequência e gravidade), propondo ações preventivas e corretivas.
  • Implementar e manter programas legais de SST, como PPRA (NR‑9) e PCMSO (NR‑7), garantindo o monitoramento dos ambientes de trabalho quanto à exposição a agentes nocivos e a correta aplicação das medidas de proteção.
  • Supervisionar as práticas de segurança de empresas terceirizadas, assegurando alinhamento às normas legais e políticas internas, bem como realizar integrações e treinamentos de segurança para prestadores de serviços e motoristas terceiros.
  • Implementar e manter o Plano de Atendimento a Emergências (PAE), realizando simulados periódicos, avaliando tempos de resposta e ajustando procedimentos, sistemas e dispositivos de segurança quando necessário.
  • Coordenar a CIPA conforme a NR‑5, garantindo sua eleição, capacitação, funcionamento, reuniões periódicas e execução das ações preventivas.
  • Garantir que os sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndio estejam instalados, operacionais e em conformidade com a legislação, acompanhando inspeções e manutenções de extintores, hidrantes, sprinklers e alarmes.
  • Gerenciar demandas de fiscalizações e auditorias, assegurando conformidade legal e tratamento eficaz de não conformidades.
  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e utilizar KPIs de Segurança do Trabalho para avaliação da eficácia das ações e suporte à melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a área de Saúde Ocupacional, apoiando campanhas preventivas, avaliações ergonômicas e ações para redução de LER/DORT e doenças ocupacionais.
  • Manter atualizada a documentação legal e técnica de SST, como laudos, PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT e relatórios de inspeções e auditorias, além de elaborar relatórios gerenciais periódicos.
  • Garantir a conformidade contínua com a legislação de Segurança do Trabalho, acompanhando alterações normativas e ajustando políticas e procedimentos internos.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria, inovação, modernização e automação de processos relacionados à Segurança do Trabalho e Emergências, visando eficiência operacional e otimização de custos;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.



Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia de segurança do trabalho e afins;
  • Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Conhecimento em gestão SIF (Serious, Injuries and Fatalities)

  • Conhecimentos SAP



Diferencial


  • Conhecimento de programas de gestão comportamental, confiabilidade humana e Hearts and minds;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de crises;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de PSM (Process, Safety e Management);
  • Inglês nível avançado

About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.

Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.


Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.


A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.


A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a Cloudbees DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision

Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

title: SAP SD Lead Consultant

  • Advanced English skills—comfortable presenting solutions to C-level stakeholders and authoring detailed functional specifications

Nice to Haves

  • Fluency in Spanish

A Vaga:


Buscamos uma pessoa Estagiária para integrar o time de Marketing – Desenvolvimento de Produtos da Stanley Black & Decker em São Paulo/SP. Esta posição é responsável por apoiar o ciclo operacional de desenvolvimento e lançamento de produtos, cuidando desde o cadastro técnico até o acompanhamento com as unidades. A pessoa ideal para esta cadeira possui um perfil analítico, disciplinado e organizado, com foco total na execução de tarefas, gestão de dados e conformidade de prazos.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar o cadastro de novos produtos e a gestão de dados nos sistemas.

  • Apoio administrativo geral na organização de arquivos de rastreamento de produtos legados e novos.


Competências e Qualificações:


  • Estar cursando entre o 3º e o 6º semestre do curso superior em Administração, Marketing, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (mandatório).

Queremos que nossa empresa seja um lugar onde você queira estar – e permanecer. Fazer parte do nosso time significa que você poderá:


  • Crescer: Faça parte de nossa empresa global com mais de 20 marcas para desenvolver suas habilidades em diversas trajetórias de carreira.

Além disso, você sentirá orgulho de capacitar criadores, realizadores, protetores e heróis do dia a dia em todo o mundo. Somos mais do que a empresa nº 1 em ferramentas. Mais do que uma força motriz em equipamentos de energia para áreas externas. Mais do que um líder global em indústria. Somos visionários e inovadores. title: Analista de segurança de TI (Pleno)
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

A Atos é líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Analista de CyberSegurança Pleno– Híbrido 2x na semana em Londrina/PR


Objetivo do cargo

Atuar de forma autônoma na operação e sustentação dos controles de segurança, conduzindo análises, acompanhamentos técnicos e interface com áreas internas e fornecedores, garantindo evolução contínua dos processos e maior maturidade operacional.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir o processo de gestão de vulnerabilidades com Saint , incluindo análise de criticidade, priorização, acompanhamento de remediação, indicadores e reports executivos/operacionais.
  • Operar e evoluir o programa de conscientização com Hacker Rangers , acompanhando indicadores de engajamento, campanhas, trilhas e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Realizar administração operacional e acompanhamento de soluções de proteção de servidores e endpoints , com foco em CrowdStrike para servidores e Defender , Trend Micro ou Trellix para endpoints.
  • Atuar nas rotinas de gestão de identidade , revisão de acessos, hardening de autenticação, controles de MFA, ciclo de vida de usuários e boas práticas de acesso com JumpCloud .
  • Apoiar a governança e a operação de cofre de senhas e acessos privilegiados com VaultOne .
  • Realizar análise e tratativa de achados relacionados ao monitoramento de marca digital com Axur , articulando ações com áreas responsáveis.
  • Apoiar a operação de SIEM , fazendo correlação básica, refinamento de casos, acompanhamento de alertas e interface com times de monitoração.
  • Elaborar procedimentos, fluxos operacionais, relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de segurança.
  • Acompanhar fornecedores, controles contratados e ações corretivas.
  • Apoiar auditorias, evidências, controles internos e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa ou em fase final em Segurança da Informação, Redes, Sistemas, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em segurança da informação com atuação prática em pelo menos parte dos temas: vulnerabilidades, EDR/AV, IAM, cofre de senha, awareness, SIEM.
  • Capacidade de analisar riscos, priorizar demandas e conduzir tratativas com autonomia.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Windows, servidores, redes, identidade e controles de segurança.
  • Boa escrita para elaboração de relatórios e comunicação com áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática com Saint, Hacker Rangers, CrowdStrike, JumpCloud, VaultOne, Axur e plataformas SIEM.
  • Vivência em ambientes corporativos com múltiplos fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks como NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001 .
  • Experiência com indicadores, apresentações executivas e planos de ação.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Brazil
description:
About Group-IB


Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Singapore, Group-IB is a leading creator of cybersecurity technologies to investigate, prevent, and fight digital crime. Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses and citizens and support law enforcement operations.

Group-IB’s Digital Crime Resistance Centres (DCRCs) are located in the Middle East, Europe, Central Asia, and Asia-Pacific to help critically analyze and promptly mitigate regional and country-specific threats. These mission-critical units help Group-IB strengthen its contribution to global cybercrime prevention and continually expand its threat-hunting capabilities.

Each of us can help make the world a safer place.

Join us!


The role:


As a Senior Business Development Manager at Group-IB , you will be a key member of our LATAM Sales Team, driving sales strategies, meeting revenue targets and building clients’ relationships. You will lead sales teams, develop sales plans, and ensure customer satisfaction. This role involves prospecting, negotiating deals, and potentially managing a sales team, requiring strong leadership and communication skills.


This role is ideal for a motivated, self-starting sales professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make a tangible impact in one of the world’s most dynamic markets


Tasks to solve:


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Develops and implements sales strategies, manages sales pipelines, and monitors performance to achieve sales goals.
  • Team Leadership: Leads and motivates a sales team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
  • Client Relationship Management: Builds and maintains strong client relationships, identifies new opportunities, and ensures customer satisfaction.
  • Prospecting and Sales Generation: Identifies and targets potential clients, generates leads, and manages the sales process.
  • Negotiation and Deal Closure: Negotiates contracts, closes deals, and ensures profitable sales.
  • Performance Analysis and Reporting: Analyses sales data, identifies trends, and provides performance reports to management.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Monitors market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works with marketing, product development, and other departments to align strategies and achieve business goals.
  • Admin: Deliver accurate sales forecasting and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM.
  • Trusted Partner: Position Group-IB as a trusted cybersecurity advisor through a consultative sales approach and a deep understanding of client challenges.


Qualifications


  • Experience: 10+ years of proven experience with sales, mainly in Cybersecurity.
  • Language: Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Role-based in São Paulo.
  • Leadership: Motivating, guiding, and developing a sales team.
  • Communication: Effectively conveying information, building rapport, and negotiating.
  • Strategic Thinking: Developing and implementing effective sales plans.
  • Relationship Building: Building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Problem-Solving: Addressing challenges and finding solutions to improve sales performance.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with CRM software and other sales tools


Why GROUP-IB?


  • Your happiness is important to us: We want every single team member to be happy.
  • Continuing professional development: At Group-IB, you can choose from various paths to growth: progress as an expert, advance to a management position, try your hand in another department, relocate abroad, or launch a new business area.
  • Group-IB.A team with extensive international expertise: Do you have experience but are looking for exciting challenges? By choosing us, you will be choosing complex tasks and continuously improving your skills in a fast-growing international company.
  • Globally recognized technologies: Group-IB's members are located in 25 countries, and our products and services are sold in 60 countries. What’s more, Gartner, IDC, and Forrester have ranked our technologies among the best in their class. We work with over 450 international partners and about 500 clients.
  • A culture created by each of us: Group-IB’s employees speak many different languages and understand one another. We respect each other's beliefs, share common values, and strive toward the happiness of every employee.
  • Economic stability: Group-IB's sustainable growth helps rapidly develop careers that would take years to progress as far as most other companies.


What else should you know:


  • Flexible schedule: Group-IB does not have fixed working hours. You choose your schedule. We adhere to the principle advocated by Steve Jobs: “We have to work not 12 hours and head. ”Health: If anything goes wrong, don’t worry — we offer health insurance.
  • Certificates and training courses : Group-IB specialists hold over 1,000 professional certificates, including CEH, CISSP, OSCP, GIAC, MCFE, BSI, as well as some rare ones that would be a source of pride for experts in forensics, penetration testing, and reverse engineering worldwide. We have an incentive program that helps employees achieve certifications at the company's expense.
  • Challenges: A wide selection of GIB programs helps you improve soft skills, gain new competencies, and receive monetary rewards.
  • The initiative is rewarded: At Group-IB, you can bring your most daring ideas to life. The company encourages technical blogging, writing articles, building sports teams, and other creative activities.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um Analista de Segurança da Informação e Redes Pleno para integrar nosso time de Infraestrutura de Segurança. Esse profissional será responsável por administrar e evoluir soluções de segurança, identificar e analisar riscos e vulnerabilidades, monitorar continuamente os ambientes e atuar na resposta a incidentes cibernéticos. Sua atuação será fundamental para garantir a proteção dos dados, a integridade dos sistemas e a continuidade dos serviços críticos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Administrar e monitorar soluções de segurança e appliances de rede;
  • Atuar na gestão e troubleshooting de ambientes SD-WAN;
  • Implementar, suportar e evoluir soluções de NAC (Network Access Control);
  • Administrar e manter antivírus corporativo e soluções de EDR/XDR;
  • Realizar análises de risco e vulnerabilidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Monitorar continuamente os sistemas de segurança e redes para detectar e responder a incidentes;

title: Growth Analyst | Internship
description:
O que a Liora faz

O Brasil tem um mercado de energia elétrica de R$ 300 bilhões por ano. A maioria das pessoas paga a conta todo mês sem questionar o valor, sem entender as opções e sem receber nada em troca além do serviço básico. A Liora muda essa equação.


A gente transforma a conta de luz em um produto financeiro — com cashback real, acesso a crédito e uma experiência que faz sentido para quem usa. O cliente economiza, a gente cresce, e o dinheiro que antes ficava parado numa conta de concessionária começa a circular de volta pra vida das pessoas.


Não é uma ideia. Em três meses de 2026 já dobramos de tamanho. A projeção é crescer 15x até dezembro. Temos backing de Canary, 17Sigma e 468 Capital — fundos que apostam em empresas com potencial de redefinir mercados inteiros. Se você quer entender como uma empresa assim é construída por dentro, essa vaga é o caminho mais curto.


Desafio

O mercado de energia é complexo, muito regulado e historicamente resistente à mudança. Isso significa que a maioria dos brasileiros ainda não sabe que pode escolher de onde vem sua energia — e os que sabem, muitas vezes não confiam em quem oferece.


Escalar num mercado assim exige mais do que anúncio bem feito — exige entender o que faz uma pessoa confiar, decidir e agir. Quem entrar nessa vaga vai trabalhar exatamente nisso: entender o que quebra a resistência do cliente, o que gera conversão de verdade e como transformar esse aprendizado num processo que escala.


Meta/Google Ads, Metabase, SQL, Python, N8N e Sheets são apenas ferramentas. O trabalho real é entender por que algo funciona — e saber replicar isso em escala sem perder a eficiência.


Por que essa vaga é diferente

A maioria das vagas \"de marketing\" te coloca pra promover posts, reportar métricas e esperar aprovação de três camadas hierárquicas. Essa não.


Você vai sentar do lado de quem toma decisão desde o primeiro mês. Vai ter acesso aos números reais da empresa — CAC, LTV, taxa de conversão por canal, por criativo, por oferta. Vai propor experimentos, defender sua lógica e ver o resultado aparecer em tempo real. É o tipo de exposição que a maioria das pessoas leva anos pra conseguir. Aqui você tem isso desde o começo.


Perfil que buscamos

Você não precisa ter experiência em marketing, em energia ou em nenhuma área específica. Você precisa:

  • Gostar de números de verdade — não só de ler dashboard, mas de questionar o que está por trás dele.
  • Conseguir pegar um problema confuso e quebrar em partes que podem ser testadas
  • Ter mais curiosidade do que certeza, e mais disposição pra errar rápido do que medo de estar errado
  • Ser ambicioso no sentido real da palavra — alguém que pensa em construir algo grande, não só em ter um emprego que paga bem


Se você está na faculdade, querendo mais do que aula teórica, e quer entender como uma empresa de verdade cresce na prática — essa vaga é pra você!

title: Analista de QA Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um profissional com sólido embasamento teórico e prático em garantia de qualidade, que entenda a automação como uma ferramenta estratégica e não apenas como execução de scripts. Valorizamos o perfil autodidata , a curiosidade investigativa e a capacidade de se adaptar rapidamente a novas tecnologias e metodologias.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Estratégia de Testes: Analisar requisitos e documentos técnicos para desenhar cenários de teste que cubram até o aceite do usuário (UAT).
  • Garantia de Qualidade de Ponta a Ponta: Projetar e executar testes funcionais, de regressão, integração e exploratórios.
  • Colaboração Ativa: Atuar em conjunto com Desenvolvedores e Product Managers para identificar riscos de qualidade precocemente (Shift-Left).
  • Métricas e Reporte: Criar relatórios de defeitos e cobertura de testes que gerem insights reais para a tomada de decisão.
  • Lifelong Learning: Demonstrar proatividade em aprender novas ferramentas, linguagens e frameworks de teste de acordo com a necessidade do produto.
  • Mentalidade de Estudo: Participar e promover sessões de compartilhamento de conhecimento (Tech Talks, Pair Testing) com o time.
  • Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de transitar entre diferentes contextos (Web, Mobile, API) com base em fundamentos sólidos de engenharia de software.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Fundamentos de Automação: Conhecimento sobre a lógica de automação de testes, arquitetura de frameworks (como Page Objects) e pirâmide de testes.
  • Vivência em QA: Experiência sólida em testes manuais e exploratórios em interfaces Web, Mobile e testes de API.
  • Cultura Ágil: Domínio de práticas Ágeis e Lean, entendendo o papel do QA em squads de alta performance.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Testes: Experiência prática com ferramentas como Jira , Xray ou Zephyr .

Diferenciais Técnicos:

  • Conhecimento conceitual ou prático nos frameworks Playwright e Appium .
  • Noções de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc.) para entender como os testes se encaixam no fluxo de entrega contínua.


Soft Skills

  • Habilidade Analítica: Capacidade de decompor problemas complexos e propor soluções simples.
  • Comunicação: Saber explicar o \"porquê\" de um bug ou de uma estratégia de teste de forma clara para perfis técnicos e de negócio.
  • Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em um ambiente dinâmico.

title: Gerente de Produto e Serviços Técnicos Sênior SAR
description:
A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

In this position, you will be responsible for ensuring an optimal user experience, higher approval rates, operational efficiency, and strict adherence to security and regulatory standards. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, driving the evolution of our payment ecosystem in Latin America.


Key Responsibilities

  • User & Market Insights: Understand user behavior and mindset through deep-dive research, data mining, observation, and E2E testing.
  • Channel Expansion: Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to expand Brazilian payment channels for global merchants.
  • Integration Management: Lead the E2E transaction flow and manage the integration of payment channels onto the Alipay platform , from contract review to go-live.
  • Merchant Solutions: Identify payment pain points for Brazil-based merchants; propose and implement innovative solutions to solve them.
  • Product Excellence: Strengthen foundational product elements, including payment processing, settlement, and merchant services, to enhance competitiveness and user satisfaction.
  • Competitive Analysis: Monitor the Latin American competitive landscape and emerging trends to identify untapped opportunities and unmet needs.
  • Performance Tracking: Define and track key product performance metrics, continuously iterating to improve customer experience.
  • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary product contact and advocate, both internally and externally.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in payment products, with a strong focus on Pix and card payment processing .
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of digital wallets, payment technology, and the Latam fintech ecosystem.
  • Product Design: Proven track record in E2E payment product design and implementation is highly preferred.
  • Technical Savvy: Hands-on experience working with both business and technical teams, translating requirements into clear product specifications.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong data-driven decision-making skills and ability to perform competitor analysis and strategic planning.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrix environment that requires high cross-functional collaboration.
  • Global Mindset: Comfortable working across different time zones.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is required.


How to Apply

If you are passionate about the future of global payments and want to make an impact in the Latam market, we want to hear from you!

title: Data Engineer (Azure/Databricks)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data solutions using Azure Databricks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of data pipelines, drive best practices in data architecture, and ensure high-quality, reliable data is delivered to support analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, ensuring alignment with lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Design and implement end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources, transform it based on business requirements, and deliver it to downstream consumers
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Apache Spark and PySpark jobs to efficiently process large-scale datasets
  • Implement data quality frameworks, validation processes, and monitoring/alerting systems to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and availability
  • Drive best practices by developing reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized approaches for data engineering across the team
  • Optimize query performance and resource utilization within Azure environments to ensure cost efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, workflows, and architecture while ensuring compliance with security and governance policies
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and promote engineering excellence within the data organization


Need to Haves


  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 2+ years working with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark, along with advanced SQL (especially Spark SQL)
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven ETL pipelines and orchestrating workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns
  • Experience with Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, REST APIs, SFTP, and Azure Key Vault
  • Proficiency in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with CI/CD practices for deploying and managing data pipelines
  • Fluent English to interact with international teams


Nice to Haves


  • Experience working with large-scale distributed data systems and performance optimization techniques
  • Familiarity with data quality, testing, and observability frameworks
  • Experience supporting analytics or data science teams with curated and accessible datasets
  • Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud data environments
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices in cloud platforms

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior
description:

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Pharmaceutical Field Specialist
description:
Job title: Field Specialist, Brazil

Job Type: Project-related part-time work (working hours depend on availability, but if you are working on a project, we ask for 1-3 days per week).


Are you looking for something flexible? Do you have sales, marketing or market research experience within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries? Are you interested in joining a fast-paced and growing global organisation?


Job Purpose:

We are looking for a Field Specialist to join our Brazil team. This role will shadow pharmaceutical representatives for the day and prepare a report based on observations made while working with the representative as they interact with their customers. The position is appointment based, depending on the size of the project and number of field days required. The position would be suitable for someone looking for project-related part-time work that leads to a long-term collaboration.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Contacting sales representatives to arrange a shadowing day in the field
  • Observing interactions between sales representatives and customers without disrupting their day (primarily face to face)
  • Conducting a 60–90-minute interview with the sales representative during the field day
  • Submitting structured reports (workbooks), translated into English, after each day in the field based on observations made within 24-48 hours of field visit
  • Attending a 30-60 min online session prior to each project to understand the project objectives and share feedback
  • Participate in project debrief calls and potentially provide feedback to assist in the development of final recommendations


Person Specification:


  • Experience in sales, marketing or market research within Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industries
  • Fluent command of Portuguese and English (written and oral)
  • Bachelor’s degree – marketing, science, or data focus is preferred
  • When working on a project, have 1-3 days availability during the week
  • Flexibility to work from morning to evening
  • Flexibility to travel within the country
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent listener
  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel


Opportunity:

  • Work with a successful and well-established company with an enviable growth trajectory
  • Working with 29 out of top 30 pharmaceutical companies globally
  • Great flexibility in managing the workload and opportunity to travel within the country
  • Structured and on-going training system and working with strong management team


If you would like to apply for this position, please submit your CV in ENGLISH.


About STEM:

STEM Healthcare is a dynamic, fast paced global pharmaceutical and life science, commercial benchmarking firm headquartered in the UK and present across six continents. STEM have developed an audit process and built a benchmarking database with more than 500,000 face-to-face observations completed across 52 countries. The benchmark provided is unique in the pharmaceutical industry consisting of over 100 KPIs, while focusing on 2-3 key priorities during formulation of action planning in order to help clients further accelerate performance.

STEM accelerates performance, improves strategic alignment, and facilitates excellence in marketing, medical, market access and account plans strategy execution. Due to the unique, specialised and highly targeted offering, STEM is experiencing a rapid growth phase, and recruiting heavily across the world. New employees will be joining at a time where rapid career development and growth opportunities are expected, as the organisation works towards their mid and long-term goals.

Vision: To always be viewed as an essential partner in enabling our clients to reach more patients with their medicines

Mission: To accelerate high performance

Core Values: Brave, Honest, Performance Driven, Practical, Customer Focused, Caring


Find us here:

Website:

STEM Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. STEM Healthcare will consider all qualified applicants for employment without discrimination on grounds of disability, sex or sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity leave status, race or national or ethnic origin, age, religion or belief, gender identity or re-assignment, marital or civil partnership status, protected veteran status (if applicable) or any other characteristic protected by law. STEM Healthcare only employs individuals with the right to work in the country/ies where the role is advertised.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA


ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.


About the Job


ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.


This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.


Key Responsibilities


Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development


  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.


Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution


  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.


Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management


  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.


Project Oversight & Value Realization


  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.


What You’ll Need


Experience


  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.


Network & Market Knowledge


  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.


Territory Management


  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.


Languages


  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.


Commercial & Strategic Skills


  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.


Remote Collaboration


  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.


Travel


  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.


Why Join us?


  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.


*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.
